caption: Ponte Vecchio, Florence
composition: Floodlit medieval bridge on the Arno at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint faces the bridge from the riverbank, the floodlit Ponte Vecchio spanning the full width of the frame with its row of shopfronts glowing amber above three stone arches. The left and right embankment walls curve away in shadow, and the still Arno doubles every light in a long golden reflection. It is 04:58 in deep night, and the second bridge glimpsed through the central arch shows how quiet the river is at this hour.
